answer.reason: Samson's visit to Timnath to seek a Philistine wife and the Philistine capture of Timnah under Ahaz are events beyond the summary; the border and town lists are not.

clauses.english: was where Samson saw a Philistine woman and asked to marry her
clauses.quote: I have seen a woman in Timnath of the daughters of the Philistines

clauses.english: was taken by the Philistines, who settled there

doubts: JOS 15:10 (border) and JOS 19:43 (list of Dan's towns) only name the place, so they were left out; Thimnathah in JOS 19:43 may be a different town.
JDG 15:6 mentions 'the Timnite' only as Samson's father-in-law, so it was not used.
